summary: A host that answers a save over a moved revision with conflict (1.22.1) gives the same reason revision_moved and the current revision as a refusal would, nothing written.

then.note: Held only when the host answers conflict (if_answer); a host that refuses passes it by group-save-revision-moved-is-a-conflict. Reason revision_moved and revision "9", the current one; nothing is written.
